report.summary: Orders service is failing to save orders due to Postgres cluster being hibernated, causing 53% 5xx errors
report.likely_cause: Postgres cluster 'orders-db' is in hibernation mode (cnpg.io/hibernation=on) leading to database unavailability
evidence: orders-db-1 pod has 18 readiness probe failures in last 3 minutes
orders service logs show transaction exception due to database connection failure

suggested_action.detail: Restart CloudNativePG cluster to wake from hibernation

rule_verdict.cause: POST /orders is failing: check orders and Postgres
